claim: Blood3D's Mixing Guide (2004-02-28, pRO) confirms Green Dye recipe requires 1 Mixture, 1 Counteragent, 20 Red Herb, 20 Yellow Herb, 5 Blue Herb, 1 Empty Bottle, and 5000 zeny in northeast Morroc
quote:
Green Dye _____________________________________________________________________________ 

* 20 Red Herb  ( Red Plant, Drops, Picky, Santa Poring, Willow, Super Picky,
                Thief Bug, Skeleton, Spore, Farmiliar, Female Thief Bug, 
                Kukre, Muka, Snake, Pecopeco, Eggyra, Dustiness, Drainliar,
                Cookie (Xmas) )
* 20 Yellow Herb ( Shining Plant, Yellow Plant, Wormtail, Pecopeco, Aster,
                    Yoyo, Male Thief Bug, Goblins, Scorpion, Anacondaq, 
                    Argos, Magnolia, Bongun, Orc Lady )
* 5 Blue Herb  ( Blue Plant, Shining Plant, Spore, Marin, Poison Spore,
                 Megalodon, Neraid, Nightmare, Cramp )
* 1 Empty Bottle  ( Poring, Drops, Pecopeco Egg, Ant Egg, Roda Frog,Muka,
                    Plankton )
* 1 Counterangent
* 1 Mixture
* 5,000 zeny
=> Location: North East Building of Morroc
reasoning: Blood3D Mixing Guide GameFAQs 29037 Section V Green Dye, established in v1.0 (2004-02-28)
